question: Which typed receiver obligations are supported by strict local schema validation, and which authority/truth questions require other mechanisms?

extension_steps.step1: Local bounded correspondence/profile; no formal R01/native isomorphism claimed
extension_steps.step2: Scoped source/authority/currentness/effect-feedback/closure mechanisms; producers, burdens, interactions and falsifiers documented

cost: Frozen selected actual SQLite API calls including commit/rollback and explicit policy entries, unit weights1; fixture/evaluator separated; no pricing or global minimum
minimum_G: Exact minimum of two frozen qualifying/reference procedures only; no global algorithm optimum
Type1: No closure only where nontrivial M remained admitted/reachable under the same interfaces and budget/horizon; P excluded
Type2: P only through declared false qualification/closure; authored-case fraction, no population claim

budget.clock: synthetic now10; useful timing/expiry/for boundaries declared per case

information_boundary: Receiver gets permitted request and source/resource observations; expected labels/private truth remain in driver/evaluator; no malicious-code/OS isolation Scenario/policy simulation-kind markers remain visible to these local models; no blind generated-world search claim.

cases.human_scenario: A purchasing receiver validates a typed record and applies its admitted tenant-a amount.
The generator/input fixture returns amount as text; strict selected typing must reject coercion.
An unrequested command field appears in an otherwise typed output.
Two amount members occur in the JSON wire; preparse duplicate-member rejection is required.
The output is schema-valid for tenant-b but the receiving operation belongs to tenant-a.
An admitted but false policy source supplies limit9999, and schema-valid output repeats it; factual correctness is not established by typing.
The upstream fixture reports a refusal; the owner admits a recorded manual-review deferment.
The wire is incomplete; the owner admits a recorded deferment rather than fabricated completion.
The typed record is valid but current operation authority is revoked.

acceptance: All qualified case expectations and separately declared Type1/Type2 sensitivity controls match; expected P/Ø retained; no deployment acceptance
statistical_rule: Report n/d over named authored cases only; no representative sample, population rate or confidence interval
amendment: Before remaining studies execute: withhold expected/world/T2 cause fields from all receiver APIs; compute observability for interval from timestamps; conventional queue reference recovers its local receipt before redelivery effects.
